title: Apple announces the HomePod Mini 2, but it isn’t ready for Siri AI at launch
summary: Apple is announcing the long-awaited HomePod Mini 2 with a new chip that can power Siri AI - but support for those new AI features won't be available at launch. The speaker is also getting a new sound glow feature that syncs its LED lights with a song's album art, and it can now be […]
